"'''Ars Dangor'''" was the pseudonym taken by a ''[[Galactic Weekly NewsStack]]'' arts correspondent. Dangor reported on the feud between the [[Band/Legends|bands]] ''[[Deeply Religious]]'' and ''[[The Emperor's New Clothes]]''.
